items.title: Peter Ecklund interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998
items.q: Well I guess I liked Bix Beiderbecke and Louis Armstrong back in those days, and of course I still do now.

ctx.x: Was there one particular person, a jazz trumpeter that made you really sit up and say that’s somebody I’d really like to sound like? © Fiillius Jazz Archive -3-
Well I guess I liked Bix Beiderbecke and Louis Armstrong back in those days, and of course I still do now.

I had a feeling you might say that, listening to what you play, that I could hear that in your sound. Can you explain — this is always a tough question — in fact you came through the classical school.
